messages.subject: Hexbin labels and inset svg
parts:
Greetings,

Does anyone know a way to print a label or some text in the center of an occupied bin?

For instance if you have a density plot that you hexbin, and the item that is in the bin has an ID. I want to print the ID of that item inside the bin.

Example here using hexbin rather than ggplot2:

http://spark.rstudio.com/adefries/HexbinDat/

Secondarily, I would like to print an svg graphic in side the bin. The bin represents a compound in chemical space, so it would be nice for the user to see the compound that is in the bin.

Thank you,

Andrew
